from pathlib import Path

from modules.integrations_center.communications_routes import router, _safe_doc


def test_gate5d_generic_routes_are_provider_neutral():
    paths = {route.path for route in router.routes}
    assert '/communications/configs' in paths
    assert '/communications/templates' in paths
    assert '/communications/providers' in paths
    assert '/communications/queue' in paths
    assert '/communications/logs' in paths
    assert all('twilio' not in path.lower() and 'whatsapp' not in path.lower() for path in paths)


def test_gate5d_generic_routes_require_canonical_permissions():
    source = (Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'modules/integrations_center/communications_routes.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert "NOTIFICACIONES_VER" in source
    assert "NOTIFICACIONES_CONFIGURAR" in source
    assert "NOTIFICACIONES_ENVIAR" not in source


def test_gate5d_generic_routes_never_return_secrets():
    safe = _safe_doc({'provider':'x','token':'a','auth_token':'b','api_key':'c','password':'d','secret_ref':'e','normal':'ok'})
    assert safe == {'provider':'x','normal':'ok'}

def test_gate5d_route_module_uses_sql_repository_alias():
    source = (Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'modules/integrations_center/communications_routes.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'NotificationRepository' in source
    assert 'pymongo' not in source.lower()
    assert 'StubDatabase' not in source
